rules.draws: automatic claim on actual third repetition or halfmove_clock >= 100; mate/stalemate take precedence
rules.max_plies: draw; count includes forced opening moves
rules.fault: forfeit recorded, entire run invalidated and stopped; no selective replay
rules.tt: both cleared before each game; retained between moves within a game
rules.book: only the same forced opening for both engines

protocol.ordering: seeded SHA256 opening order, rotated seeded level order, consecutive swapped-color pairs
